pair.title: MOVAhome
pair.region_label: Cloud region of your MOVAhome account
pair.password_hint: Set a password in the official MOVAhome app first. Homey only accepts email and password — not a verification code from mova.tech. If you signed up with Apple ID, open MOVAhome → account → Forgot password / Set password, then enter that email and password here.
pair.missing: Enter your MOVAhome email, password, and region. Set a password in the MOVAhome app first if you used Apple ID.

error.login_missing: Enter your MOVAhome email, password, and region. Set a password in the MOVAhome app first if you used Apple ID.

settings.title: Rooms
settings.subtitle: Refresh rooms creates a tag for every room. The tags are in MOVA Vacuum. Drop them into the Flow card, next to each other. Refresh again after you merge or rename rooms in MOVAhome.
settings.empty: No rooms yet. Let the robot finish a map in MOVAhome, then refresh.
settings.rooms_empty: No rooms found on the robot map. Finish a map in MOVAhome, then try again.
settings.room_missing: Pick a room from the list. Refresh rooms in the app settings if it is missing.
settings.room_tags_empty: Drop one or more room tags from MOVA Vacuum.
settings.room_tags_only: Only room tags from MOVA Vacuum work here. Refresh rooms and drop the tags again if one is missing.

map.no_device: Select a MOVA vacuum in the widget settings.
map.no_map: No map yet. Start a clean so the robot can send a floor plan.
